question: Which of the following chemicals/gases is/are responsible for causing the greenhouse effect? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (10/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: NO2, CO2 and SO2,
Water vapour, CO2 and CFCs
NO2, O2 and SO2,
Water vapour, O2 and CFCs
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Water vapour, CO2 and CFCs

Explanation:
Greenhouse effect is a process where certain gases in Earth's atmosphere trap heat from the sun, increasing the planet's temperature. Major greenhouse gases include Carbon Dioxide (CO2), Water Vapour (H2O), Methane (CH4), Nitrous Oxide (N2O), and Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs). These gases absorb infrared radiation emitted from Earth, trapping heat. Among the given options, water vapour, CO2, and CFCs are all greenhouse gases. NO2 and SO2 are not greenhouse gases but air pollutants. O2 is not a greenhouse gas. Thus, the correct answer is Option 2.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Major greenhouse gases → CO2, CH4, N2O, CFCs, water vapour
☛ Gas contributing most to greenhouse effect → Water vapour
☛ Largest anthropogenic greenhouse gas contribution → CO2
☛ Main source of CFCs → Refrigeration, air conditioning, aerosol sprays
☛ Rising temperature due to greenhouse effect → Global warming
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा रसायन/गैस ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव उत्पन्न करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है/हैं? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (10/02/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: NO2, CO2 और SO2
जल वाष्प, CO2 और CFC
NO2, O2 और SO2
जलवाष्प, O2 और CFC
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है जल वाष्प, CO2 और CFC

Explanation:
ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में कुछ गैसें सूर्य से आने वाली ऊष्मा को रोककर पृथ्वी के तापमान को बढ़ा देती हैं। प्रमुख ग्रीनहाउस गैसों में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (CO2), जल वाष्प (H2O), मीथेन (CH4), नाइट्रस ऑक्साइड (N2O) और क्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन (CFC) शामिल हैं। ये गैसें पृथ्वी से उत्सर्जित अवरक्त विकिरण को अवशोषित करती हैं, जिससे गर्मी फंस जाती है। दिए गए विकल्पों में, जल वाष्प, CO2 और CFC सभी ग्रीनहाउस गैसें हैं। NO2 और SO2 ग्रीनहाउस गैसें नहीं हैं, बल्कि वायु प्रदूषक हैं। O2 ग्रीनहाउस गैस नहीं है।

☛ सबसे अधिक ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव उत्पन्न करने वाली गैस → जल वाष्प
☛ मानवजनित ग्रीनहाउस गैसों में सबसे बड़ा योगदान → CO2
☛ CFC का मुख्य स्रोत → प्रशीतन, एयर कंडीशनिंग, एरोसोल स्प्रे
☛ ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव के कारण बढ़ता तापमान → ग्लोबल वार्मिंग

question: Which of the following is NOT the United Nations' legal instrument for protection of climate system? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: United Nations Framework Convention On Climate Change
Kyoto Protocol
United Nations International Panel on Climate Change
Paris Agreement
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is United Nations International Panel on Climate Change

Explanation:
The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), the Kyoto Protocol, and the Paris Agreement are legal instruments for the protection of the climate system. UNFCCC, signed in 1992, is an international environmental treaty providing a framework to combat climate change. The Kyoto Protocol, adopted in 1997, set binding emission reduction targets for developed countries. The Paris Agreement, adopted in 2015, involves all countries in climate action. In contrast, the United Nations International Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) is a scientific body that assesses climate change but is not a legal instrument or treaty. It provides information to policymakers but does not create binding rules.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ First treaty to address climate change → UNFCCC (1992)
☛ Kyoto Protocol had targets for which countries → Developed countries
☛ Paris Agreement was adopted in → 2015
☛ Full form of IPCC → Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change
☛ IPCC is a → Scientific body
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जलवायु प्रणाली की सुरक्षा के लिए संयुक्त राष्ट्र का कानूनी साधन नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/02/2021) Shift 1)

क्योटो प्रोटोकॉल
संयुक्त राष्ट्र अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु परिवर्तन पैनल

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है संयुक्त राष्ट्र अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु परिवर्तन पैनल

Explanation:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु परिवर्तन पर रूपरेखा सम्मेलन (UNFCCC), क्योटो प्रोटोकॉल और पेरिस समझौता जलवायु प्रणाली की सुरक्षा के लिए कानूनी साधन हैं। UNFCCC 1992 में हस्ताक्षरित एक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पर्यावरण संधि है जो जलवायु परिवर्तन से निपटने के लिए ढांचा प्रदान करती है। क्योटो प्रोटोकॉल 1997 में अपनाया गया था और इसमें विकसित देशों के लिए बाध्यकारी उत्सर्जन लक्ष्य निर्धारित किए गए थे। पेरिस समझौता 2015 में अपनाया गया और इसमें सभी देशों को शामिल किया गया। इसके विपरीत, संयुक्त राष्ट्र अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु परिवर्तन पैनल (IPCC) एक वैज्ञानिक निकाय है, जो जलवायु परिवर्तन पर रिपोर्ट तैयार करता है, लेकिन यह एक कानूनी साधन या संधि नहीं है। यह नीति निर्माताओं के लिए जानकारी प्रदान करता है, बाध्यकारी नियम नहीं बनाता।

question: How many biodiversity hotspots does India host? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Five
Three
Four
Two
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Four

Explanation:
India hosts four major biodiversity hotspots: the Himalayas, the Western Ghats, the Indo-Burma region (including Northeast India), and Sundaland (the Nicobar Islands). These areas are rich in endemic and rare species. Biodiversity hotspots are regions with high levels of biodiversity that are under severe threat. Although these hotspots cover only about 2.4% of India's land area, they harbor nearly 50% of the country's plant species. Their conservation is crucial for maintaining ecological balance and human well-being.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ How many biodiversity hotspots are there globally? → 36
☛ How many hotspots are located in India? → 4
☛ Which is the oldest hotspot in India? → Western Ghats
☛ Which hotspot includes Northeast India? → Indo-Burma
☛ Which hotspot includes the Nicobar Islands? → Sundaland

question: The Ramsar Convention is for the: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (15/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: conservation of soil fertility
conservation of tropical forests
conservation of wetlands
control of ozone layer depletion
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is conservation of wetlands

Explanation:
The Ramsar Convention is an international treaty for the conservation and sustainable use of wetlands. It is named after the city of Ramsar in Iran, where the convention was signed in 1971. Its main objective is to protect wetland ecosystems and ensure sustainable use of their aquatic resources. Under the Ramsar Convention, wetlands are designated as Ramsar sites, which are globally important wetland areas. India has over 75 Ramsar sites. Wetlands include marshes, lakes, river floodplains, and mangroves.

Important facts:
☛ When was the Ramsar Convention signed? → 1971
☛ What is the main objective of the Ramsar Convention? → Conservation and sustainable use of wetlands
☛ Which were the first Ramsar sites in India? → Chilika Lake and Keoladeo National Park (1981)
☛ How many Ramsar sites are there globally? → Over 2,400
☛ What is the importance of wetlands? → Biodiversity, water purification, flood control

question: Which of the following publishes the Red List of Threatened Species? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: UNEP
WNO
WWF
IUCN
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is IUCN

Explanation:
The Red List of Threatened Species is published by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). It is the world's most comprehensive inventory of the global conservation status of biological species, assessing their risk of extinction. The IUCN Red List classifies species into categories such as Extinct, Critically Endangered, Endangered, and Vulnerable. Established in 1948, IUCN is headquartered in Gland, Switzerland. UNEP is the United Nations Environment Programme, WWF is the World Wide Fund for Nature, and WNO is often confused with WHO. Therefore, IUCN is the correct answer.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Purpose of IUCN Red List → To assess extinction risk of species
☛ IUCN Headquarters → Gland, Switzerland
☛ IUCN Founded Year → 1948
☛ Highest threat category in Red List → Extinct
☛ Code for 'Critically Endangered' in Red List → CR
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन संकटग्रस्त प्रजातियों की लाल सूची प्रकाशित करता है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/03/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: UNEP
WNO
WWF
IUCN
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है IUCN

Explanation:
IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) द्वारा प्रकाशित Red List of Threatened Species विश्व की जैव विविधता की स्थिति का सबसे व्यापक स्रोत है। यह प्रजातियों के विलुप्त होने के जोखिम का आकलन करता है और उन्हें विभिन्न श्रेणियों जैसे विलुप्त, गंभीर रूप से संकटग्रस्त, संकटग्रस्त और असुरक्षित में वर्गीकृत करता है। IUCN की स्थापना 1948 में हुई थी और इसका मुख्यालय स्विट्जरलैंड के ग्लैंड में स्थित है। UNEP संयुक्त राष्ट्र पर्यावरण कार्यक्रम है, WWF वर्ल्ड वाइड फंड फॉर नेचर है, और WNO आमतौर पर विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन से संबंधित है। अतः IUCN ही सही उत्तर है।

question: Which of the following resources is a fossil fuel? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Coal
Wind Power
Hydropower
Nuclear Power
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Coal

Explanation:
Fossil fuels are resources formed from the remains of dead organisms over millions of years under high pressure and temperature. Coal, petroleum, and natural gas are the main fossil fuels. Coal originates from compressed plant matter and is widely used for electricity generation and industrial processes. In contrast, wind power, hydropower, and nuclear power are non-fossil, renewable, or nuclear energy sources. Fossil fuels are non-renewable and are major contributors to carbon emissions, leading to environmental concerns. Understanding the distinction between renewable and non-renewable resources is crucial for energy and environmental studies.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Major fossil fuels? → Coal, Petroleum, Natural Gas
☛ Coal is formed from? → Compressed plant remains
☛ Most used fossil fuel? → Coal
☛ How are fossil fuels formed? → Decomposition of organic matter
☛ Disadvantage of fossil fuels? → Pollution and limited availability
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संसाधन जीवाश्म ईंधन है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)

Explanation:

question: The Chipko movement was related with: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (06/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: environment protection
human rights
freedom struggle
women's rights
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is environment protection

Explanation:
The Chipko movement was a famous environment protection movement in India that started in 1973 in the Himalayan region of Uttarakhand (then Uttar Pradesh). Its main objective was to prevent deforestation and protect forests. Villagers, especially women, hugged trees to stop loggers. The movement was led by Gaura Devi, Chandi Prasad Bhatt, and Sunderlal Bahuguna. It later spread across India, creating awareness about forest conservation. The movement highlights the importance of green cover and ecological balance.

question: Taj Mahal is said to be suffering from “Marble Cancer”. What is Marble Cancer? (RRB JE CE (29/08/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Brown Carbon
Acidic rain which corrodes marble
Large number of Fungi in Taj Mahal marbles
All of the options
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Acidic rain which corrodes marble

Explanation:
Marble cancer is primarily caused by acid rain. Acid rain contains sulfuric acid and nitric acid, which react with calcium carbonate, the main component of marble, forming gypsum (calcium sulfate). Gypsum is water-soluble and weakens the marble surface, leading to cracks and flaking. The Taj Mahal is affected by emissions from nearby industries, especially the Mathura Refinery. This process destroys the luster and strength of marble, hence it is called 'cancer'.

question: Which of the following is NOT a green house gas? (RRB JE CE (19/09/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: Carbon dioxide
Methane
Hydrochlorofluorocarbons
Oxygen
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Oxygen

Explanation:
Greenhouse gases are gases that absorb and emit infrared radiation in Earth's atmosphere, causing the greenhouse effect. The major greenhouse gases include carbon dioxide (CO₂), methane (CH₄), nitrous oxide (N₂O), hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), and water vapor (H₂O). These gases allow sunlight to enter the atmosphere but trap heat radiated from Earth's surface, leading to global warming. Oxygen (O₂) is a vital component of the atmosphere but does not absorb infrared radiation and thus does not contribute to the greenhouse effect. Hence, oxygen is not a greenhouse gas.

☛ Highest global warming potential among greenhouse gases → Sulfur hexafluoride (SF₆)
☛ Greenhouse gas used in refrigeration → Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs)
☛ Gas not responsible for greenhouse effect → Oxygen

question: Which of the following fossil fuels has methane as its main constituent? (RRB JE CBT I (01/06/2019) Shift 2)

solution:

question: Which of the following is the natural fuel formed deep under the Earth from the pre-historic remains of living organisms like plants and animals? (RRB JE CBT I (02/06/2019) Shift 1)

question: Which of the following is correct about trophic levels in a food chain?  (RRB Technician Grade III (10/03/2026) Shift 1)
options: The herbivores or the secondary consumers come at the second level.
The heterotrophs fix up the solar energy and make it available for herbivores or other consumers.
The Larger carnivores or the tertiary consumers form the third trophic level.
The autotrophs or the producers are at the first trophic level.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is The autotrophs or the producers are at the first trophic level.

Explanation:
In a food chain, trophic levels represent the flow of energy in an ecosystem. The first trophic level consists of autotrophs or producers that fix solar energy through photosynthesis. The second trophic level comprises herbivores or primary consumers, not secondary consumers. The third trophic level includes secondary consumers (small carnivores), and the fourth trophic level has tertiary consumers (large carnivores). Heterotrophs (like consumers) do not fix solar energy; they obtain energy from producers. Thus, only option 4 is correct.

☛ Second trophic level → Primary consumers (Herbivores)
☛ Third trophic level → Secondary consumers (Small carnivores)

☛ Energy fixation → Only by producers (Autotrophs)

Explanation:
खाद्य श्रृंखला में ट्राफिक स्तर पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में ऊर्जा प्रवाह को दर्शाते हैं। पहले ट्राफिक स्तर पर स्वपोषी या उत्पादक होते हैं जो प्रकाश संश्लेषण द्वारा सौर ऊर्जा को स्थिर करते हैं। दूसरे स्तर पर शाकाहारी या प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता आते हैं, न कि द्वितीयक उपभोक्ता। तीसरे स्तर पर द्वितीयक उपभोक्ता (छोटे मांसाहारी) और चौथे स्तर पर तृतीयक उपभोक्ता (बड़े मांसाहारी) होते हैं। विषमपोषी (जैसे उपभोक्ता) सौर ऊर्जा स्थिर नहीं करते, बल्कि उत्पादकों से ऊर्जा प्राप्त करते हैं। अतः केवल विकल्प 4 सही है।

question: Which of the following options is NOT a greenhouse gas? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

Nitrous oxide
Carbon dioxide
solution:

Although it can contribute to the greenhouse effect, its greenhouse potential is low, and it is primarily classified as an ozone-depleting substance. Therefore, among the given options, carbon tetrachloride is the gas that is not commonly included in the list of greenhouse gases.

question: Degradation of global environment has not resulted in one of the following. (RRB NTPC Tier I (22/04/2016) Shift 2)

question: In the context of climate change, what is the full form of GHGs?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/03/2021) Shift 1)

question: Which of the following greenhouse gases is NOT included under the Kyoto Protocol? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (23/07/2021) Shift 2)
options: Nitrous oxide
Carbon dioxide
Methane
Ozone
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ozone

Explanation:

It covers six main greenhouse gases: Carbon dioxide (CO₂), Methane (CH₄), Nitrous oxide (N₂O), Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), Perfluorocarbons (PFCs), and Sulfur hexafluoride (SF₆). Ozone (O₃) is not included under the Kyoto Protocol because it is a tropospheric pollutant that contributes to the greenhouse effect but is regulated under the Montreal Protocol. Thus, ozone is not part of the Kyoto Protocol's list.

question: The method of storage of nuclear wastes is to be done in _______. (RRB JE CBT 2 (Electronics Engineering) ReExam (04/06/2025))
options: bottles
dustbins
open containers
shielded containers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is shielded containers

Explanation:
Nuclear wastes are highly radioactive and must be stored in specially designed shielded containers to prevent radiation leakage. These containers are made of materials like lead or concrete that absorb radiation and protect the environment. This method is used in deep geological repositories, where waste is buried underground in stable rock formations. Other options such as bottles, dustbins, or open containers are unsafe for handling radioactive materials due to lack of protection. Shielded containers are essential to minimize health risks and environmental contamination. They ensure safe containment for thousands of years until the radioactivity decays to safe levels.

question: The greenhouse gas that is known to contribute the least amount to global warming is ___________. (RRB JE CBT 2 (Electronics Engineering) ReExam (04/06/2025))
options: carbon dioxide
methane
CFCs
nitrous oxide
solution:

Explanation:
Nitrous oxide (N₂O) is a potent greenhouse gas, but its contribution to global warming is the least among the given options. The primary reason is its low atmospheric concentration. Carbon dioxide (CO₂) contributes the most due to its high abundance and long atmospheric lifetime. Methane (CH₄) is the second largest contributor to the greenhouse effect. CFCs damage the ozone layer and also contribute to the greenhouse effect, but their concentration is higher than N₂O. Therefore, nitrous oxide contributes the least to global warming.

question: _____ is the most efficient method used for the disposal of hospital-generated waste. (RRB JE CBT 2 (Electronics Engineering) ReExam (04/06/2025))
options: Sanitary landfills
Incinerator
Furnace
Open dumps
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Incinerator

Explanation:
Hospital waste includes infectious, sharp, and hazardous materials that need specialized disposal. An incinerator burns these wastes at high temperatures, turning them into ash, destroying pathogens, and reducing volume by up to 90%. This method prevents the spread of infections and controls environmental pollution. Sanitary landfills and open dumps are unsuitable for infectious waste as they can contaminate groundwater and soil. Furnaces are typically used for industrial waste. Incineration is the most efficient method for hospital waste because it ensures complete destruction of harmful microorganisms and minimizes environmental impact.

question: What is the reason for CFC free refrigerators being manufactured for use throughout the world?  (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (18/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: CFC makes refrigeration a tough process.
CFC is a synthetic chemical which depletes the ozone layer.
CFC is tough to handle for the refrigeration industry.
CFC is cheap for use in refrigerators.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CFC is a synthetic chemical which depletes the ozone layer.

Explanation:
CFC (Chlorofluorocarbon) is a synthetic chemical used in old refrigerators. It depletes the ozone layer, which protects the Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation. To prevent ozone layer depletion, CFC-free refrigerators are manufactured worldwide. The 1987 Montreal Protocol banned the production and use of CFCs. CFCs are being replaced with safer alternatives like Hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) or Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs). The impact of CFC on the ozone layer is measured by Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP). CFC-free refrigerators are environmentally friendly and comply with global regulations.

☛ What measures the impact of CFC on the ozone layer? → Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP)
☛ What is a common alternative to CFC in refrigerators? → Hydrofluorocarbon (HFC)
☛ Which radiation is blocked by the ozone layer? → Harmful ultraviolet radiation

Explanation:
CFC (क्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन) एक सिंथेटिक रसायन है जिसका उपयोग पुराने रेफ्रिजरेटरों में किया जाता था। यह ओजोन परत को नष्ट करता है, जो पृथ्वी को हानिकारक पराबैंगनी विकिरण से बचाती है। ओजोन परत के क्षरण को रोकने के लिए, दुनिया भर में CFC मुक्त रेफ्रिजरेटर बनाए जाते हैं। 1987 के मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल ने CFC के उत्पादन और उपयोग पर प्रतिबंध लगाया। CFC को हाइड्रोफ्लोरोकार्बन (HFC) या हाइड्रोक्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन (HCFC) जैसे सुरक्षित विकल्पों से बदला जा रहा है। CFC का ओजोन परत पर प्रभाव ओजोन क्षरण क्षमता (ODP) से मापा जाता है। CFC मुक्त रेफ्रिजरेटर पर्यावरण के अनुकूल होते हैं और वैश्विक नियमों का पालन करते हैं।

question: Which of the following is an eco-friendly practice? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (11/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: Use of chemical fertilizers to increase crop productivity
Disposing waste plastics by dumping in pits under soil
Disposal of biodegradable wastes in ponds
Disposing dry leaves in pits under soil
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Disposing dry leaves in pits under soil

Explanation:
Eco-friendly practices are those that do not harm the environment and conserve resources. Disposing dry leaves in pits under soil is a biodegradable waste management method, where leaves decompose naturally into compost, enriching soil fertility. In contrast, excessive use of chemical fertilizers leads to soil and water pollution. Burying plastic waste in soil does not degrade it and causes land pollution. Disposing biodegradable waste in water bodies causes water pollution and harms aquatic life. Thus, disposing dry leaves in pits is a sustainable and environmentally friendly practice. This method mimics natural decomposition, reduces landfill burden, and produces useful compost for plants.

प्राकृतिक पर्यावरण के कई कार्य हैं, जिनमें सौंदर्य सेवाएं भी शामिल हैं। यह परिदृश्य, वन्यजीव और प्राकृतिक दृश्य प्रदान करता है, जो मानव कल्याण और पर्यटन में योगदान देता है। अन्य विकल्प सही हैं: पर्यावरण संसाधनों की आपूर्ति करता है, आनुवंशिकी और जैव विविधता प्रदान करके जीवन को बनाए रखता है, और अपशिष्ट को स्वांगीकृत करता है। इसलिए कथन 1 गलत है।

question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding the storage of grains?
(RRB JE (20/02/2026) Shift 2)
options: Abiotic factors responsible for losses in stored grains are temperature, rodents and fungi.
Biotic factors responsible for losses in stored grains are insects, rodents and moisture.
Biotic factors responsible for losses in stored grains are insects, rodents and fungi.
Storage losses in agriculture produce can be very low.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Biotic factors responsible for losses in stored grains are insects, rodents and fungi.

Explanation:
Losses in stored grains are caused by biotic factors such as insects, rodents, and fungi. These living organisms damage grains by feeding on them or contaminating them. Abiotic factors like temperature and moisture influence the extent of damage but are not direct causes. Insects like weevils and beetles bore into grains, rodents eat and spoil grains, and fungi cause mold and decay. Thus, the correct group of biotic factors includes insects, rodents, and fungi. Storage losses can be significant if proper management is not done.

question: Which of the following best explains why humans have the highest concentration of harmful chemicals in their bodies? (RRB Technician Grade III (06/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: They eat large quantities of contaminated animal products
They consume more pesticides directly than other organisms
They are exposed to chemicals through air and water
They occupy the top trophic level in food chains
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is They occupy the top trophic level in food chains

Explanation:
The highest concentration of harmful chemicals in humans is due to biomagnification, a process where toxins increase in concentration at each trophic level of a food chain. As humans are at the top trophic level, they consume organisms that have accumulated toxins from lower levels. Small organisms like plankton absorb chemicals in low amounts, but larger predators accumulate them through their diet. Ultimately, humans, being apex consumers, receive the highest dose. The other options such as eating contaminated animal products or direct pesticide exposure are limited factors, while exposure through air and water affects all organisms equally and does not explain the highest concentration.

☛ How does toxicity increase in biomagnification? → At each level of the food chain
☛ What is the main cause of biomagnification? → Toxins are not easily broken down
☛ Which chemicals are examples of biomagnification? → DDT and mercury
☛ Which organisms have the highest toxicity at the top trophic level? → Humans and large fish
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सर्वोत्तम रूप से वर्णन है कि मनुष्यों के शरीर में हानिकारक रसायनों की सांद्रता सर्वाधिक क्यों होती है? (RRB Technician Grade III (06/03/2026) Shift 2)

वे वायु और जल के माध्यम से रसायनों के संपर्क में आते हैं।
वे खाद्य श्रृंखलाओं में शीर्ष पोषण स्तर पर होते हैं।
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है वे खाद्य श्रृंखलाओं में शीर्ष पोषण स्तर पर होते हैं।

Explanation:
मनुष्यों के शरीर में हानिकारक रसायनों की सर्वाधिक सांद्रता का कारण जैव आवर्धन (biomagnification) है। यह प्रक्रिया खाद्य श्रृंखला के प्रत्येक स्तर पर विषाक्त पदार्थों की सांद्रता को बढ़ाती है। मनुष्य शीर्ष पोषण स्तर पर होते हैं, इसलिए वे सबसे अधिक संचित विषाक्त पदार्थों को ग्रहण करते हैं। छोटे जीव जैसे प्लवक और मछलियाँ कम मात्रा में रसायन लेते हैं, लेकिन बड़ी मछलियाँ और अंततः मनुष्य इन्हें खाकर अत्यधिक सांद्रता प्राप्त कर लेते हैं। अन्य विकल्प जैसे दूषित जंतु उत्पादों का सेवन या प्रत्यक्ष पीड़कनाशी के संपर्क में आना सीमित कारण हैं, जबकि वायु और जल के माध्यम से संपर्क सभी जीवों को समान रूप से प्रभावित करता है।
